items.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021
items.q: It just, you know we heard Bill Evans and Miles and Coltrane when we were in our early teens. I mean that just captivated us.

ctx.x: It just, you know we heard Bill Evans and Miles and Coltrane when we were in our early teens. I mean that just captivated us. How could we compare that with what was being played on the radio at that time? We’re talking 1960 now. There really is no comparison. I have grown to love the pop music from that era now. I listen to it now. I’m playing catch-up with that and really enjoying it. At the time, Monk, I had no use for it whatsoever.

When you were listening to Bill Evans and Cannonball and all that, did you sense the song form and what the band was doing to make a seven minute performance into a cohesive listenable piece of music?
